source_snapshot.title: Five-day break announced for Dubai private school students for 55th Eid Al Etihad
source_snapshot.text: Dubai: Students at Dubai’s private schools and higher education institutions will enjoy a five-day break for the UAE’s 55th Eid Al Etihad, the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA) announced today, November 19. Private schools and higher education institutions across Dubai will be closed from Wednesday, December 2, to Friday, December 4, with classes and normal operations resuming on Monday, December 7, as per the announcement. Holiday dates for nurseries The authority also announced that Dubai’s early childhood centres will be closed on Wednesday, December 2, and Thursday, December 3. However, depending on the needs of the families and communities they serve, centres may also choose to remain closed on Friday, December 4, extending the holiday to five days, including the weekend on Saturday and Sunday, and normal operations would then resume on Monday, December 7. KHDA also announced that its offices will remain closed from December 2 to 4, with normal office hours resuming on Monday, December 7.

evidence_passages.text: Five-day break announced for Dubai private school students for 55th Eid Al Etihad

Dubai: Students at Dubai’s private schools and higher education institutions will enjoy a five-day break for the UAE’s 55th Eid Al Etihad, the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA) announced today, November 19.

Private schools and higher education institutions across Dubai will be closed from Wednesday, December 2, to Friday, December 4, with classes and normal operations resuming on Monday, December 7, as per the announcement.
Holiday dates for nurseries The authority also announced that Dubai’s early childhood centres will be closed on Wednesday, December 2, and Thursday, December 3.

However, depending on the needs of the families and communities they serve, centres may also choose to remain closed on Friday, December 4, extending the holiday to five days, including the weekend on Saturday and Sunday, and normal operations would then resume on Monday, December 7.
KHDA also announced that its offices will remain closed from December 2 to 4, with normal office hours resuming on Monday, December 7.

Учебные занятия возобновятся 7 декабря. Детские сады закроются 2 и 3 декабря, а при необходимости могут оставаться закрытыми и 4 декабря. Офисы KHDA также будут закрыты в эти даты.
